ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   D. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   D. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

10. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)

   B. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)

14. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour
